spike_notes: Rank-two ultimate and coordinated mid-game fights
reasoning: Aatrox converts levels, ability haste and sustained access into a strong mid-game fight. His output depends on landing chained abilities and receiving enough resources to survive through healing windows.
Annie offers a direct burst-and-engage plan whose most important windows depend on stun preparation and access to the target rather than a complex mechanical sequence.

spike_notes: Prepared weapon cycle before an objective
reasoning: Aphelios is a resource-intensive carry whose fight output rises with items and deliberate weapon preparation. The composition must create safe space and arrive with the correct setup.
Braum contributes primarily through protection, counter-engage and passive coordination. His value depends more on enemy access patterns and allied follow-up than personal gold.
Caitlyn can create early lane and structure pressure, but the draft must convert that control and bridge item-dependent troughs. Trap setup and protected range determine later fight access.
Ezreal converts early item completions and repeated skill-shot access into mid-game pressure. His safety is valuable, but missed abilities sharply reduce the composition's damage output.

spike_notes: Early levels with access to all basic abilities
reasoning: Lee Sin creates early access, skirmish and displacement windows. The value of the pick depends on converting tempo and executing the correct role as raw damage becomes less central later.

spike_notes: Ultimate available against an exposed carry
reasoning: Vi provides reliable single-target access and a direct engage signal. She is strongest when the composition can immediately follow her commitment and convert the isolated target.
Xerath converts items and prepared space into long-range health advantages. His output is execution-sensitive and drops when opponents bypass the setup phase.
Support Xerath trades lower guaranteed income for early range pressure. The pick must create lane or setup value while avoiding direct engage and flank access.
Zyra creates lane pressure and prepared zone control without requiring carry-level income. Her strongest fights begin in controlled terrain before opponents gain clean access.

Alistar supplies reliable short-range engage or counter-engage without requiring income. His draft value depends on choosing between starting the fight and holding cooldowns to protect allied damage dealers.

Camille converts solo-lane income into side-lane pressure and reliable target isolation. In team fights she needs a synchronized entry or follow-up because committing beyond the frontline can separate her from allied damage.

spike_notes: Two- to three-item pick and objective setup
reasoning: Jhin supports picks and engages from range before converting control into burst damage. He needs prepared spacing and struggles to provide continuous damage into several durable targets without allied setup.

spike_notes: A marked target separated from protection
reasoning: Locke is a setup-dependent assassin whose teleporting pursuit and missing-health damage reward decisive target selection. He needs income and a prepared entry, while failed commitment spends health and position without guaranteeing an exit.

Nautilus provides layered single-target control and can either force a carry or peel a diver. He does not need much income, but missed or poorly chosen engage angles can leave him isolated from allied follow-up.

spike_notes: Ultimate available against an isolated carry
reasoning: Nocturne turns darkness and long-range access into a clear single-target commitment. He needs lanes or allied control to finish the target and becomes vulnerable when entering the full enemy protection layer alone.

Renekton converts early lane resources, fury and flank access into durable mid-game pressure. His threat drops when opponents deny early conversion or force him to enter without fury and allied follow-up.

Bot Tristana is an income-dependent carry who converts resets and explosive-charge windows into kills or structures. Her jump can follow a secured target, but using it as unsupported primary engage removes an important safety tool.

spike_notes: First completed fighter or tank item
reasoning: Trundle offers direct skirmish strength, objective damage and terrain disruption. He is most valuable into durable frontliners and short-range fights, while mobile or ranged opponents can deny sustained attack access.

spike_notes: First ability upgrade and mana completion
Prepared choke point around an objective
reasoning: Viktor converts lane income and completed upgrades into wave control and sustained area damage. He needs space and time for repeated spell rotations; direct multi-angle access can prevent him from establishing the fight zone.
